signal.label: NIBE
signal.rationale: Size: the stated NIBE share of INR 563.35 crore, executed within 12 months, is 123.8% of TTM revenue of INR 454.96 crore. Firmness: a signed contract with the Indian Army, so it is firm. Not routine: it is more than 1.9x the largest previously disclosed order (INR 292.69 crore) and opens loitering munitions as a new product line. Not stressed: losses are modest against revenue and equity was raised in Mar and Jun 2026, though leverage is unknown.
